summary: Both backend and frontend for SKBike Sales Form new fields fully verified. Backend: 7/7 pytest passed for POST/GET /api/sales including the 4 new optional fields (metode_pembayaran, sudah_diambil, metode_pengambilan, alamat_pengiriman) and soft-delete. Frontend (Expo web preview, mobile 375x667): PIN=8193 unlocks; entering letters Y,V,K auto-prefills Kode Barang='YVK' and derives Harga Modal Rp 1.350.000 (regression OK); Barang Terjual opens sell form. Date picker modal (date-picker-button -> datepicker-overlay) opens, prev/next month buttons work, tapping datepicker-day-15 updates date-picker-value to '15 September 2026' and closes modal; 'Hari Ini' resets to today. Segmented components for Metode Pembayaran (Cash/Transfer), Apakah Sudah Diambil (Belum/Sudah), Metode Pengambilan (Pick up Sendiri/Travel) all show red active state and toggle-deselect on repeat tap. input-alamat multiline accepts text. Simpan Penjualan navigates to /history and new card shows Cash + Travel pills plus green 'Sudah diambil' badge. WhatsApp share (window.open intercepted) opens exactly https://wa.me/628125559681?text=... containing all four new fields (Metode Pembayaran: Cash, Sudah Diambil: Sudah, Metode Pengambilan: Travel, Alamat Pengiriman: Jl. Pahlawan No. 10, Surabaya). No red screen, no pageerror. Only cosmetic RN console warnings (useNativeDriver missing on web, pointerEvents deprecated) which are Expo web internals and not blockers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Sale/SaleCreate cleanly extended with 4 optional new fields; list/get exclude Mongo _id correctly.

sell.tsx uses controlled state for all new fields with proper null coalescing on save; testIDs match spec (date-picker-button, date-picker-value, datepicker-*, pembayaran-*, diambil-*, pengambilan-*, input-alamat, save-sale-button).
date-picker-modal.tsx is dependency-free (react-native Modal + custom grid), works on web preview; overlay press closes; inner card press swallows to avoid accidental close.
segmented.tsx supports deselect (click active -> null) and provides testIDPrefix mapping.
history.tsx renders payment/pickup pills and green 'Sudah diambil' badge; buildSaleMessage appends the 4 new fields to the WhatsApp text.

Console warnings on web are benign (useNativeDriver JS fallback, pointerEvents prop deprecation from RN 0.74+). No action needed for MVP; can be addressed in future by migrating props/animations to style.pointerEvents/native-only.
server.py still uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI in favor of lifespan handlers (pre-existing, out of this change scope).
seed_data_creation: Test-only sales created via pytest are cleaned up in fixture teardown. One end-to-end sale (Kode YVK, Cash, Sudah, Travel, Jl. Pahlawan No. 10 Surabaya) was persisted via the UI flow and remains visible on Riwayat.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (currently https://cost-to-sales-pro.preview.emergentagent.com). App PIN=8193. Sell flow requires letter code first (e.g. Y,V,K on home) so kode prefill is populated. On web preview, WhatsApp share opens via window.open — intercept with page.evaluate to read window.__lastOpenedUrl. Segmented chip active color = red brandPrimary. DatePicker weekday labels are Indonesian (Min..Sab) and month label localized ('September 2026'). Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_sales_new_fields.py.
rca_of_issue: N/A — feature-verification review, no bugs found. Feature works end-to-end as specified.
